items.claim: CFO 上調 2026 全年財測，營收區間 45–46 億美元
items.quote: will be in the range of $4.5 billion to $4.6 billion
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 全年調整後 EBITDA 財測下緣 3.05 億美元（上緣 3.15 億，毛利 11.02–11.25 億）
items.quote: adjusted EBITDA to be between $305 million
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 表示 7 月延續動能，預期第三季開季為雙位數營收成長
items.quote: expect double-digit top line growth to start the third quarter.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說明財測納入保守假設，原因是中東夏季旅遊基期與第四季旅遊回流不確定
items.quote: we did build in some conservatism into the forward guidance
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明下半年營收成長較慢的原因之一：第四季將滿一年的 Atelco 收購貢獻約 70bp
items.quote: fourth quarter, and that's about 70 basis points of year-over-year growth.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說財測燃料假設是沿用現況，不假設明顯升降
items.quote: Pretty conservative assumption. We just modeled forward kind of what we're experiencing now,
items.speaker: CFO

items.quote: full year 2030 revenue of $6 billion to $6.5 billion
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 2030 長期目標：調整後 EBITDA 4.5–5.2 億美元
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA of $450 million to $520 million,
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 2030 長期目標：調整後 EBITDA margin 7.5–8%
items.quote: adjusted EBITDA margin of 7.5% to 8%.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說明長期成長率目標已按近幾季表現做風險調整（原 4–7% 上調至 7–10%）
items.quote: It is risk-adjusted to what we're doing the last couple of quarters.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明全年財測隱含調整後 EBITDA margin 6.8%
items.quote: the full year guidance implies now 6.8% adjusted EBITDA margin.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明財測相當於 Q1 與 Q2 兩次上調合併為一次
items.quote: So it's really kind of 2 raises at once
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 提供 Q2 EBITDA margin 年增幅度
items.quote: Our EBITDA margin was up 120 basis points year-over-year.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 報告 Q2 毛利率年增約 49bp（特產 47bp、肉類 75bp）
items.quote: Gross profit margins increased approximately 49 basis points.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 報告 Q2 調整後營業費用占營收比例
items.quote: adjusted operating expenses were 17.5% for the second quarter of 2026.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 回答毛利與費用端的後續空間：兩邊都有，強調從投資中取得槓桿
items.quote: You're correct. All of the above.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 表示不為 EBITDA 率設上限
items.quote: teams that I'm not capping where the EBITDA can go percentage-wise.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 把毛利率改善歸因於定價、採購團隊與科技投資
items.quote: we've made a ton of investment in our pricing teams and technology
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明德州去除低毛利非核心客戶後，德州 EBITDA margin 較前幾年大幅提升
items.quote: We've improved our overall Texas EBITDA margin by multiple hundred basis points
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 數字口徑：CEO 報告 Q2 有機淨銷售成長
items.quote: organic net sales grew 12.2%.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 數字口徑：CFO 拆解 Q2 通膨 4.9%（特產 4%、肉類 6.4%）
items.quote: inflation was 4.9% in the second quarter, consisting
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 數字口徑：Q2 獨立客戶數成長 3.6%，管理層另提排除中東影響後約 4.9%
items.quote: Unique customers grew 3.6% year-over-year.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 中東業務 5–6 月約為去年同期 94%，近週大致持平
items.quote: located there operated at approximately 94% of prior year
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 回答客戶流失率：與過去相比無重大變化
items.quote: We see a pretty consistent attrition rate in this industry
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明德州低毛利非核心大客戶專案已滿一年，德州業務成長
items.quote: Our Texas business is growing really nicely.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 表示世界盃對公司沒有明顯影響
items.quote: The World Cup, we don't think had a major impact for us.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 承認競爭激烈，並強調關係與人才難以複製
items.quote: There's plenty of competition. I mean we fight every day.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明護城河中人員能力不可被電腦取代
items.quote: You can't just rely on computers.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 談 AI 投資：管理層預期不是一次性大幅提升利潤
items.quote: expecting to get 5, 6 points to the bottom line
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 表示公司過去未稱之為 AI，但一直投資科技
items.quote: We never called it AI, but we've always been investing
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說明供應鏈：中東物流需改道、前置時間拉長、價格上升，北美採購未受影響
items.quote: we haven't seen an impact on our sourcing into North America.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明生鮮通膨主要來自物流與燃料成本，財測未假設不同於近期
items.quote: Still a small division.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO：資本支出長期平均約占營收 1%
items.quote: We expect total Capex to average approximately 1% of revenue going forward
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO：將增加庫藏股
items.quote: maintain a strong balance sheet and increase share repurchases.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO：槓桿在目標區間（淨負債／調整後 EBITDA 1.5–2.5）內時，配置更多金額給買回
items.quote: we expect to allocate more dollars to share repurchases
items.speaker: CFO

items.quote: we expect free cash flow conversion to be in the range of 40% to

items.quote: ABL debt, reducing the outstanding drawn balance to $70 million.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 對併購環境的看法：標的價格偏熱，偏好投資人才而非收購
items.quote: I think it's getting frothier and frothier.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱有機成長 ROI 優於多數正在評估的收購案
items.quote: keep investing in people. and just keep adding talent
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 承諾持續投資配送能力，列出擴建區域
items.quote: Current plans include New England, Texas, Las Vegas, the
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 指示持續招聘有潛力人才
items.quote: if you find a great talent with potential hire them.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 表示財測傾向保守、仍有超越空間
items.quote: we tend to be a little bit conservative on

qa_flags.question: Todd Brooks（Benchmark）：EBITDA margin 從今年約 6 高段走向 7 高段，進展是階梯式還是每年 20–25bp？
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 未給逐年節奏，改談財測與 5 年目標皆經風險調整、有上檔可能，並稱「you never know what the cadence is going to be exactly」；CEO 改談歷史 10% 以上 EBITDA 與不設上限

qa_flags.question: Kelly Bania（BMO）：若下半年營收維持雙位數，EBITDA 上檔空間多大？
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 先釐清問的是毛利率或 EBITDA margin、一度答錯題目（以為問 Q2），最後只答「is there upside from there? Sure」，未給數字，並重申傾向保守
